item.title: Why Your Build Needs a Standalone Harness
item.description: Still running a modified OEM harness? Here's why going standalone is the best investment for your build's reliability and performance.
item.content:encoded:
If you've ever chased an electrical gremlin through a 30-year-old OEM wiring harness, you know the pain. Modified factory harnesses carry decades of degraded insulation, corroded pins, and spliced-in aftermarket additions that create unreliable connections.

A standalone harness eliminates all of that. Every wire is purpose-built for your specific setup — no unused circuits, no mystery wires, no compromise.

item.title: MK3 Supra 2JZ Swap: Wiring Considerations
item.description: The 2JZ swap into the MK3 Supra is one of the most popular JDM builds. Here's what you need to know about the wiring side of this swap.
item.content:encoded: The MK3 Supra with a 2JZ swap is a legendary combination. But the wiring can be the most challenging part of the build if you don't plan ahead.

item.title: Choosing the Right ECU for Your 2JZ Build
item.description: Haltech, Link, AEM, Motec — the options are overwhelming. Here's our breakdown of the most popular ECU choices for 2JZ-powered builds.
item.content:encoded: Choosing an ECU is one of the most important decisions in your build. Each platform has strengths depending on your goals.

item.title: Mil-Spec Wiring Explained: TXL vs Raychem Spec 44
item.description: Not all automotive wire is created equal. Here's a deep dive into the two wire types we use at SVK Works — and when each one is the right call for your build.
item.content:encoded: Wire selection is one of the most overlooked aspects of harness building, but it directly affects reliability, longevity, and weight.

item.title: 1UZ-FE Swap Wiring: What You Need to Know
item.description: The 1UZ-FE is a proven V8 swap candidate. Here's a breakdown of the wiring challenges and how a purpose-built harness makes the install clean and reliable.
item.content:encoded: The Toyota/Lexus 1UZ-FE is one of the most popular V8 swap engines for good reason — it's compact, reliable, relatively affordable, and makes great power with modern tuning.

item.title: SC400 Manual Swap: Wiring the CD009 Conversion
item.description: Swapping a Nissan 350Z CD009 6-speed into the SC400 is one of the cleanest manual conversions available. Here's everything you need to know about the wiring side.
item.content:encoded: The Lexus SC400 is one of the best platforms for a manual transmission conversion. But the wiring requires careful attention.

item.title: Mil-Spec Connectors: Why They Matter for Motorsport Wiring
item.description: Mil-spec connectors are the gold standard for motorsport and high-performance wiring. Here's why they're worth the investment and what makes them different.
item.content:encoded: Not all connectors are created equal. When you're building a performance car that's going to see heat, vibration, moisture, and the occasional hard launch, the connectors in your wiring harness are as critical as the wire itself.
